item.title: ONE WORLD UNDER DOOM #9 Leak Reveals First Look At Marvel's New Sorcerer Supreme - SPOILERS
item.description: Tomorrow will see the release of One World Under Doom #9, the final issue in Marvel Comics' latest event. However, an early look at the Scarlet Witch's transformation into the new Sorcerer Supreme is here!

item.title: Sony Reveals PlayStation Black Friday 2025 Deals On PS5 Consoles, Games, Accessories, And More
item.description: Sony's Black Friday 2025 sale will begin on November 21st, bringing discounts to PS5 console bundles and games, as well as accessories, peripherals, and more. Check out the deals below!

item.title: “I Don’t Believe I’m A Bad Person”: SMALLVILLE’s Allison Mack Talks NXIVM, Brandings, And Suicidal Thoughts
item.description: In a surprising move, Smallville actor Allison Mack went on Inside of You with former co-star Michael Rosenbaum to talk about her involvement with NXIVM and everything that stemmed from that.

item.title: THE BRIDE! BTS Image Teases Jessie Buckley's Transformation As Maggie Gyllenhaal Teases "Monstrous" Monsters
item.description: A new behind-the-scenes image from The Bride! shows us more of Jessie Buckley's transformation into the Bride of Frankenstein as filmmaker Maggie Gyllenhaal teases a bonkers, suitably monstrous take...

item.title: NIGHT PATROL: Defang The Police In First Trailer For Vampire Cop Thriller Starring Justin Long & CM Punk
item.description: Shudder has released the first trailer for a new vampire cop thriller titled Night Patrol, which stars Justin Long, Jermaine Fowler, RJ Cyler, Freddie Gibbs, and WWE's CM Punk...

item.title: Marvel's Stormbreakers Bring Back The '90s In Must-See New X-MEN Trading Card Variant Covers
item.description: "X-Men Trading Card Variant Covers," the latest variant cover collection from the 2025 Class of Marvel's Stormbreakers, arrives in January. If you grew up or were a fan in the '90s, you'll love these!

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: Hot Toys Reveals Limited Edition Figure Based On The 1977 Series Starring Nicholas Hammond
item.description: In 1977, Spider-Man aired on CBS and brought the wall-crawler to a live-action setting for the first time. Now, Hot Toys has unveiled a 1/6th scale figure based on this unique version of Peter Parker...

item.title: THE RUNNING MAN Director Edgar Wright Reveals How He's Approaching Sydney Sweeney's BARBARELLA Movie
item.description: The Running Man director Edgar Wright has been attached to a Barbarella remake starring Sydney Sweeney for a while now, and the filmmaker has addressed how he's likely to approach the long-awaited remake.

item.title: BLACK WIDOW And THUNDERBOLTS* Star Florence Pugh Reveals The One Movie "I Wish I Never Did"
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday star Florence Pugh has reflected on an early project in her acting career that she still regrets being part of to this day. It's not an MCU movie or TV show, but is a genre title...

item.title: Closer Look At AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Costume Display Spawns A Shocking, Potentially Spoilery Doctor Doom Theory
item.description: A display in the Russo Brothers' production company, AGBO, has sparked a new wave of speculation about Doctor Doom's potential link to Variants of two members of the Fantastic Four in Avengers: Doomsday.
